snippet.title: Jump To Stratos | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Jump To Stratos is an upcoming indie game with high-stakes physics platforming where one wrong move can send you plummeting back down to the start, you'll attempt to climb this cyberpunk city as your thrown into this impossible challenge, have you got what it takes! 

Add the game to your Steam Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783440/Jump_To_Stratos/

Releasing on Steam on November 7th
